entries.03dad44ecf60e43a: The group consists of the company, six consolidated subsidiaries and eight non-consolidated subsidiaries (as of March 31, 2026). The consolidated number of employees is 2,568 (fiscal year ended March 2026). Its head office is located in Edobori, Nishi-ku, Osaka City.

entries.16d9a98ceaabbda2: It secures profits by improving profitability at the time of order receipt and by passing on rising materials and equipment prices and labor costs appropriately. Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥26,772 million.

entries.4420f5003d5e30f3: It has a structure to handle both HVAC and plumbing works and electrical works consistently, from design through supervision to construction. It has construction subsidiaries in Japan that handle part of the works, and also has subsidiaries in Thailand, Vietnam, Singapore and Taiwan to handle local works.

entries.7202ef84e17f1eef: It constructs works and receives contract fees according to completion and progress. Revenue from completed construction for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥256,228 million, a decrease of 2.5% from the previous year. By breakdown, HVAC and plumbing works were ¥206,994 million and electrical works were ¥49,234 million. Revenue in Japan, at ¥222,388 million, accounted for the majority, and Singapore was ¥32,181 million.
entries.a85da1d22115f271: It designs, supervises and constructs HVAC and plumbing works, covering building air conditioning, water supply and drainage, and sanitary facilities, as well as electrical works. Subsidiaries such as Daidan Service Kanto and Daidan Service Kansai handle part of the construction work, and subsidiaries in Thailand, Vietnam, Singapore and Taiwan also operate locally. Consolidated subsidiary Serabo Healthcare Service conducts sales of regenerative medicine-related equipment and contract manufacturing of pharmaceuticals through cell processing, among other activities.
entries.b4f05dd9f152d4be: This is a business model in which it receives orders for HVAC and plumbing works and electrical works from general contractors, business companies and government agencies, performs design, supervision and construction, and earns contract fees for the works.
entries.b54c4a640e84cd75: Construction of heating, cooling, water supply and drainage, and sanitary facilities. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥206,994 million.
entries.b664c67989d188af: Of revenue from completed construction of ¥256,228 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, HVAC and plumbing works accounted for ¥206,994 million and electrical works for ¥49,234 million, with HVAC and plumbing works making up the majority. By region, Japan accounted for the majority at ¥222,388 million, Singapore was ¥32,181 million, and others were ¥1,659 million.
entries.c27baa1463553c7f: This is the group's core business, designing, supervising and constructing air-conditioning, sanitary and electrical work. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥256,228 million. Some of the work received is constructed by subsidiaries such as Daidan Service Kanto and Daidan Service Kansai. Subsidiaries in Thailand, Vietnam, Singapore and Taiwan also conduct facility construction locally, and Presico Engineering Pte. Ltd. in Singapore operates mainly in that country.
